question: Cinnabar is the ore of which of the following metals?
solution:
The correct answer is __Mercury__.

__
 
• **Cinnabar (HgS) is an ore of Mercury.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Cinnabar **is a toxic mercury sulfide mineral of mercury with a chemical composition of HgS. 
 
• The name cinnabar is derived from the Greek name kinnabari.
 
• Its appearance is bright scarlet to brick-red colour.
 
• Because of its colour, it was used as jewellery and ornaments for thousands of years in many parts of the world.
